subject: Hospitality
title: Predicting Demand Patterns
description: A quick, practical guide to Predicting Demand Patterns.

hook.text: Revenue managers can predict hotel occupancy months in advance with surprising accuracy. The patterns are remarkably consistent.

buildup.text: Hotels analyze years of historical data: which days fill first, when groups book, how weather affects leisure travel.

discovery.text: A city hotel might see Monday–Thursday business demand drop on Friday, then leisure travelers fill the gap on weekends.

twist.text: Unexpected events—pandemics, natural disasters, surprise concerts—can shatter forecasts overnight. Models never capture.

climax.text: The best forecasters blend historical data with market intelligence: upcoming events, airline schedules, and competitive moves.

punchline.text: Patterns repeat, surprises happen. Forecasting is probability, not certainty.

quiz.question: What data do hotels use for demand forecasting?
options: Historical patterns, events, weather, airline schedules, and competitor data
